prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Find object, approach it, grab it, process its properties, and stop or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectWithinReach    /> <Condition ID = IsAtTargetLocation    /> <Action ID = StopMoving    /> <Action ID = ApproachObjectLocation    /> <Action ID = StartMoving    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectWithinReach? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObjectProperties
	END
